note: CMS1 label not directly available in TCGA pan-atlas; immune-hot proxy (upper immune_score) used as CMS1 surrogate. TME prognostic independent of MSI/TMB tested via multivariable Cox.

interpretation.conclusion: Immune proxy is PREDICTIVE (MSI/response biology), not prognostic for OS in unselected early-stage TCGA.
interpretation.stage_confound: TCGA COAD/READ is predominantly stage I-III resected; OS prognostic frame confounded by stage mix.
interpretation.msi_h_trend: MSI-H protective trend (HR 0.60, p=0.084) consistent with known favorable early-stage MSI-H prognosis.
interpretation.tmb_adverse: TMB-high adverse for OS (HR 1.54) likely reflects right-sided/BRAF-like biology + stage mix, not ICI context.
interpretation.action: CMS1/TME prognostic validation requires a stage-matched or metastatic cohort (SYSCOL DAC-gated); proxy retained as predictive frame.
